---
description: "Prepare a truthful PR description, changelog entry, test evidence, and reviewer checklist"
name: "SDLC 8 — PR Preparation"
agent: "PR Preparation Agent"
argument-hint: "Verified changes and test evidence"
---

Follow [the PR preparation skill](../skills/pr-preparation/SKILL.md). Read the verified diff, actual test evidence, known limitations, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`.

Prepare the required Summary (2–3 sentences), Changes Made, Test Evidence, Known Limitations, and Reviewer Checklist. Add a concise changelog entry following existing style. Do not invent test output, CI links, or a PR URL.

Ask before committing, pushing, or opening a PR. If no remote/GitHub capability is available, leave PR material prepared locally and explain that no PR was created.
